---
title: "Fetal liver: integration benchmark figures"
---

Run after the whole pipeline (01-05). Every figure is written under `figures/`:

```
figures/
  scores/scores.csv                    batch / bio score of every method in every case
  scores/scores_<case>.png             batch removal vs biological conservation, one per case
  scores/scores_all_cases.png          all cases side by side, shared axes
  pareto/pareto_<case>.png             same scatter with the Pareto front, one per case
  umap/<case>/<NN>_<method>.png        UMAP coloured by species | EBCC label
  spatial/<section>/<NN>_<annotator>.png  ImageDimPlot per cell-type annotator
```

Cases: `full_mouse`, `dissected_mouse`, and `genes2`-`genes8` (the dissected section
with 20-80% of the shared genes dropped).

```{r setup}
source('../library.R')
source('../source.R')
source('integration_datasets.R')   # the six cases: concat / out (04) / scores (05) paths
library(rhdf5)
library(patchwork)   # side-by-side UMAP panels

fig_dir = Sys.getenv('FIG_DIR', 'figures')
overwrite = TRUE                    # FALSE: skip UMAP / spatial images that already exist

case_titles = c(full_mouse      = 'Full mouse section',
                dissected_mouse = 'Dissected mouse section',
                genes2          = 'Dissected, 20% of shared genes dropped',
                genes4          = 'Dissected, 40% of shared genes dropped',
                genes6          = 'Dissected, 60% of shared genes dropped',
                genes8          = 'Dissected, 80% of shared genes dropped')

# methods: 04 output file and the obsm key holding that method's own UMAP
# (a plain X_umap in most 04 files is the unintegrated UMAP carried over)
methods = tribble(
  ~method,              ~file,                        ~umap_key,
  'Unintegrated',       NA,                           'X_umap',
  'Unintegrated UINMF', NA,                           NA,          # UMAP of the raw UINMF H matrix
  'FastMNN',            '04.01_FastMNN.h5ad',         'X_umap_mnn',
  'SAMap',              '04.02_SAMap.h5ad',           'X_umap',
  'CCA',                '04.03_CCA.h5ad',             'X_umap_cca',
  'Harmony',            '04.04_Harmony.h5ad',         'X_umap_harmony',
  'Scanorama',          '04.05_Scanorama.h5ad',       'X_umap_scanorama',
  'RPCA',               '04.06_RPCA.h5ad',            'X_umap_rpca',
  'scVI',               '04.07_scVI.h5ad',            'X_umap_scvi',
  'scANVI',             '04.08_scANVI.h5ad',          'X_umap_scanvi',
  'BBKNN',              '04.09_BBKNN.h5ad',           'X_umap_bbknn',
  'LIGER',              '04.10_LIGER.h5ad',           'X_umap_liger',
  'LIGER UINMF',        '04.11_LIGER_UINMF.h5ad',     'X_umap',
  'FastMNN UINMF',      '04.12_FastMNN_UINMF.h5ad',   'X_umap_mnn_uinmf',
  'CCA UINMF',          '04.13_CCA_UINMF.h5ad',       'X_umap_cca_uinmf',
  'Harmony UINMF',      '04.14_Harmony_UINMF.h5ad',   'X_umap_harmony_uinmf',
  'Scanorama UINMF',    '04.15_Scanorama_UINMF.h5ad', 'X_umap_scanorama_uinmf',
  'RPCA UINMF',         '04.16_RPCA_UINMF.h5ad',      'X_umap_rpca_uinmf',
  'BBKNN UINMF',        '04.17_BBKNN_UINMF.h5ad',     'X_umap_bbknn_uinmf'
) |>
  mutate(base  = str_remove(method, ' UINMF'),
         uinmf = if_else(str_detect(method, 'UINMF'), 'UINMF', 'Base'),
         # file-name prefix: the 04.xx number, 00 / 00b for the two unintegrated baselines
         id    = coalesce(str_extract(file, '^04\\.\\d+'),
                          if_else(method == 'Unintegrated', '04.00', '04.00b')))

base_cols = c(Unintegrated = '#000000', FastMNN = '#E69F00', SAMap = '#0072B2',
              CCA = '#009E73', Scanorama = '#D55E00', RPCA = '#332288',
              Harmony = '#AA4499', BBKNN = '#999933', scVI = '#882255',
              scANVI = '#CC6677', LIGER = '#8C510A')
species_cols = c(hsapiens = '#4477AA', mmusculus = '#EE6677')

# one colour per cell type, shared by every UMAP and spatial plot
celltypes = c('Hepatocyte', 'HSPC', 'Erythroid progenitor', 'Erythroblast', 'Erythrocyte',
              'Megakaryocyte', 'Mast cell', 'Granulocyte', 'Mono/Macrophage',
              'Dendritic cell', 'B cell', 'T/NK/ILC', 'Endothelial', 'Fibroblast')
celltype_cols = setNames(c('#1F77B4', '#AEC7E8', '#FF7F0E', '#FFBB78', '#D62728', '#2CA02C',
                           '#98DF8A', '#9467BD', '#C5B0D5', '#8C564B', '#E377C2', '#17BECF',
                           '#BCBD22', '#7F7F7F'), celltypes)

save_plot = function(p, file, width = 11, height = 7) {
  dir.create(dirname(file), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  ggsave(file, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = 'white')
}
```

## Batch removal vs biological conservation

Each axis is the plain mean of the scib metrics available for a method (all are
already on 0-1). Graph-only methods (BBKNN, SAMap) have no embedding, so their
PCR / ASW metrics are missing and they are averaged over the rest.

```{r scores-functions}
batch_metrics = c('PCR_batch', 'ASW_label/batch', 'iLISI', 'graph_conn')
bio_metrics   = c('NMI_cluster/label', 'ARI_cluster/label', 'ASW_label',
                  'isolated_label_F1', 'isolated_label_silhouette', 'cLISI')

# one 05 csv (rows = metrics, one column named after the method) -> long format
read_metrics = function(f) {
  df = read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique_quiet")
  tibble(metric = df[[1]], value = as.numeric(df[[2]]), method = names(df)[2])
}

# per method and case: mean of the available batch / bio metrics. Score files older
# than the case's 03 data come from an earlier run of the pipeline and are left out.
case_scores = function() {
  imap_dfr(datasets, function(d, case) {
    files = list.files(d$scores, pattern = '^05\\..*\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
    stale = file.mtime(files) < file.mtime(paste0(d$concat, '.h5ad'))
    if (any(stale)) warning(case, ': skipping score files from an earlier run: ',
                            paste(basename(files[stale]), collapse = ', '), call. = FALSE)
    map_dfr(files[!stale], read_metrics) |>
      mutate(group = case_when(metric %in% batch_metrics ~ 'batch',
                               metric %in% bio_metrics   ~ 'bio')) |>
      filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(value)) |>
      group_by(method, group) |>
      summarise(score = mean(value), n_metrics = n(), .groups = 'drop') |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(score, n_metrics)) |>
      rename(batch = score_batch, bio = score_bio) |>
      mutate(case = case)
  }) |>
    left_join(select(methods, method, base, uinmf), by = 'method') |>
    mutate(base  = factor(base, levels = names(base_cols)),
           uinmf = factor(uinmf, levels = c('Base', 'UINMF')),
           case  = factor(case, levels = names(datasets)))
}

shape_scale = scale_shape_manual(values = c(Base = 16, UINMF = 2), name = 'Gene set', drop = FALSE,
                                 labels = c(Base = 'Shared orthologs', UINMF = 'Shared + unshared (UINMF)'))

# colour = base algorithm, shape = gene set, dashed cross = Unintegrated's scores
plot_scores = function(s, title = NULL) {
  ref = s |> filter(method == 'Unintegrated')
  ggplot(s, aes(batch, bio)) +
    geom_vline(data = ref, aes(xintercept = batch, linetype = 'Unintegrated'), colour = 'grey40') +
    geom_hline(data = ref, aes(yintercept = bio,   linetype = 'Unintegrated'), colour = 'grey40') +
    geom_point(aes(colour = base, shape = uinmf), size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, name = 'Base algorithm', drop = FALSE) +
    shape_scale +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Unintegrated = 'dashed'), name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2),
           linetype = guide_legend(order = 3)) +
    labs(title = title, x = 'Batch removal score', y = 'Biological conservation score') +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank())
}

# Pareto front: a method is on it if no other method in the same case is at least as
# good on both scores and strictly better on one. Front points are full size and
# labelled, the rest dimmed; the line is the staircase edge of what the front dominates.
pareto_flag = function(batch, bio) {
  map2_lgl(batch, bio, \(b, s) !any(batch >= b & bio >= s & (batch > b | bio > s)))
}

plot_pareto = function(s, title = NULL) {
  s = s |> mutate(pareto = pareto_flag(batch, bio))
  front = s |> filter(pareto) |> arrange(batch)
  ref = s |> filter(method == 'Unintegrated')
  ggplot(s, aes(batch, bio)) +
    geom_vline(data = ref, aes(xintercept = batch, linetype = 'Unintegrated'), colour = 'grey40') +
    geom_hline(data = ref, aes(yintercept = bio,   linetype = 'Unintegrated'), colour = 'grey40') +
    geom_step(data = front, direction = 'hv', colour = 'grey30', linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = filter(s, !pareto), aes(colour = base, shape = uinmf),
               size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_point(data = front, aes(colour = base, shape = uinmf), size = 4.5, stroke = 1.6) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = front, aes(label = method, colour = base),
                             size = 4.5, fontface = 'bold', show.legend = FALSE,
                             max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0,
                             box.padding = 0.6, seed = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, name = 'Base algorithm', drop = FALSE) +
    shape_scale +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Unintegrated = 'dashed'), name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2)),
           shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2)),
           linetype = guide_legend(order = 3)) +
    labs(title = title, x = 'Batch removal score', y = 'Biological conservation score',
         caption = 'Line: Pareto front. Labelled points are Pareto-optimal; dimmed points are dominated.') +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10))
}
```

```{r scores}
scores = case_scores()
dir.create(file.path(fig_dir, 'scores'), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(scores, file.path(fig_dir, 'scores', 'scores.csv'))

# every method should have a score in every case
missing = expand_grid(case = names(datasets), method = methods$method) |>
  anti_join(mutate(scores, case = as.character(case)), by = c('case', 'method'))
if (nrow(missing) > 0) warning('no scores for:\n',
                               paste(missing$case, missing$method, sep = ': ', collapse = '\n'))

for (case in names(datasets)) {
  s = filter(scores, case == !!case)
  save_plot(plot_scores(s, title = case_titles[[case]]),
            file.path(fig_dir, 'scores', str_glue('scores_{case}.png')))
  save_plot(plot_pareto(s, title = case_titles[[case]]),
            file.path(fig_dir, 'pareto', str_glue('pareto_{case}.png')))
}
save_plot(plot_scores(mutate(scores, case = factor(case_titles[as.character(case)],
                                                   levels = case_titles))) +
            facet_wrap(~ case, nrow = 2),
          file.path(fig_dir, 'scores', 'scores_all_cases.png'), width = 18, height = 10)
```

## UMAPs: species | EBCC label

```{r umap-functions}
# one obs column of an h5ad (plain or categorical), without loading the whole file
read_h5ad_obs = function(file, col) {
  if (col == '_index') col = h5readAttributes(file, 'obs')[['_index']]
  path = paste0('obs/', col)
  # categorical columns are a group of categories + integer codes (-1 = NA)
  is_categorical = with(h5ls(file, recursive = 2), any(group == '/obs' & name == col & otype == 'H5I_GROUP'))
  x = if (is_categorical) {
    cats = as.character(h5read(file, paste0(path, '/categories')))
    codes = as.integer(h5read(file, paste0(path, '/codes')))
    ifelse(codes < 0, NA, cats[codes + 1])
  } else as.character(h5read(file, path))
  h5closeAll()
  x
}

read_h5ad_umap = function(file, key) {
  emb = t(h5read(file, paste0('obsm/', key)))[, 1:2]
  h5closeAll()
  data.frame(cell = read_h5ad_obs(file, '_index'), umap_1 = emb[, 1], umap_2 = emb[, 2])
}

# UMAP of the raw UINMF H matrix (no integration on top)
uinmf_h_umap = function(out_dir) {
  H = as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(out_dir, 'uinmf_H_raw.csv'), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
  H = H[rowSums(abs(H)) > 0 & apply(is.finite(H), 1, all), ]   # same cells the UINMF methods keep
  emb = uwot::umap(H, n_neighbors = 30, metric = 'cosine', min_dist = 0.3, seed = 42,
                   init = 'pca', n_threads = n_threads)
  data.frame(cell = rownames(H), umap_1 = emb[, 1], umap_2 = emb[, 2])
}

plot_umap = function(d, title) {
  d = slice_sample(d, prop = 1)                   # random draw order: no species on top
  # zoom to the central 99% of cells on each axis; a few scattered outliers would
  # otherwise shrink the main structure (the subtitle reports how many are cut)
  xl = quantile(d$umap_1, c(0.005, 0.995)); yl = quantile(d$umap_2, c(0.005, 0.995))
  xl = xl + c(-0.05, 0.05) * diff(xl);      yl = yl + c(-0.05, 0.05) * diff(yl)
  n_out = sum(d$umap_1 < xl[1] | d$umap_1 > xl[2] | d$umap_2 < yl[1] | d$umap_2 > yl[2])
  panel = function(col, values, name) {
    ggplot(d, aes(umap_1, umap_2, colour = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 0.3, stroke = 0) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = values, name = name, na.value = 'grey80') +
      guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
      coord_equal(xlim = xl, ylim = yl) +
      theme_void(base_size = 12)
  }
  (panel('species', species_cols, 'Species') | panel('celltype', celltype_cols, 'EBCC label')) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = title,
                    subtitle = sprintf('%d cells (%d outside the view)', nrow(d), n_out))
}

umap_case = function(case) {
  d = datasets[[case]]
  concat = paste0(d$concat, '.h5ad')
  meta = data.frame(cell     = read_h5ad_obs(concat, '_index'),
                    species  = read_h5ad_obs(concat, 'orig.ident'),
                    celltype = read_h5ad_obs(concat, 'celltype'))
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(methods))) {
    m = methods[k, ]
    out = file.path(fig_dir, 'umap', case, sprintf('%s_%s.png', m$id, str_replace_all(m$method, ' ', '_')))
    if (file.exists(out) && !overwrite) next
    emb = if (m$method == 'Unintegrated') {
      read_h5ad_umap(concat, m$umap_key)
    } else if (m$method == 'Unintegrated UINMF') {
      uinmf_h_umap(d$out)
    } else {
      f = file.path(d$out, m$file)
      e = read_h5ad_umap(f, m$umap_key)
      # SAMap names cells by bare barcode ('hs'/'mm' in orig.ident); barcodes repeat
      # across species, so rebuild the '<species>_<barcode>' names from it
      if (m$method == 'SAMap')
        e$cell = paste0(c(hs = 'hsapiens_', mm = 'mmusculus_')[read_h5ad_obs(f, 'orig.ident')], e$cell)
      e
    }
    dd = inner_join(emb, meta, by = 'cell')
    if (nrow(dd) < 0.95 * nrow(emb)) warning(case, ' / ', m$method, ': only ', nrow(dd), ' of ',
                                             nrow(emb), ' cells matched the concatenated data')
    save_plot(plot_umap(dd, sprintf('%s - %s', m$method, case_titles[[case]])), out, width = 14, height = 6)
    message('saved ', out)
  }
}
```

```{r umap}
for (case in names(datasets)) umap_case(case)
```

## Spatial plots per cell-type annotator

The human section and the full and dissected mouse sections, coloured by each of the
five annotations from 02: same-species reference (Seurat, SingleR), cross-species
reference (Seurat, SingleR), and the EBCC consensus. One image per annotator.

```{r spatial}
sections = c(human           = 'data/02_annotated_data/02_human_annotated.rds',
             mouse_full      = 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds',
             mouse_dissected = 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_subset_annotated.rds')
annotators = c('01_same_species_seurat'   = 'celltype_seurat',
               '02_same_species_singleR'  = 'celltype_singleR',
               '03_cross_species_seurat'  = 'celltype_seurat_cross',
               '04_cross_species_singleR' = 'celltype_singleR_cross',
               '05_ebcc'                  = 'ebcc_label')
annotator_titles = c(celltype_seurat = 'Same-species reference: Seurat',
                     celltype_singleR = 'Same-species reference: SingleR',
                     celltype_seurat_cross = 'Cross-species reference: Seurat',
                     celltype_singleR_cross = 'Cross-species reference: SingleR',
                     ebcc_label = 'EBCC consensus')
spatial_cols = c(celltype_cols, Unassigned = 'grey50')   # SingleR's pruned (NA) labels

for (section in names(sections)) {
  obj = readRDS(sections[[section]])
  for (file_id in names(annotators)) {
    col = annotators[[file_id]]
    out = file.path(fig_dir, 'spatial', section, paste0(file_id, '.png'))
    if (file.exists(out) && !overwrite) next
    labs = as.character(obj@meta.data[[col]])
    labs[is.na(labs)] = 'Unassigned'
    obj$plot_label = factor(labs, levels = intersect(names(spatial_cols), unique(labs)))
    p = ImageDimPlot(obj, group.by = 'plot_label', cols = spatial_cols, size = 0.9,
                     dark.background = FALSE) +
      labs(title = sprintf('%s - %s', str_replace(section, '_', ' '), annotator_titles[[col]]),
           fill = 'Cell type') +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)))
    save_plot(p, out, width = 11, height = 9)
    message('saved ', out)
  }
  rm(obj); gc()
}
```
